_README: Hand-maintained curation overrides, applied by scripts/curate.ts after the
type allowlist. Use this for one-off judgements; when a whole CLASS of
events is affected, add its type to scripts/lib/taxonomy.ts instead, so the
fix applies to everything like it.
Diagnose first:  npm run explain -- "Berlin Conference"
include : force-keep an event the allowlist drops. `g` sets its category.
exclude : force-drop an event the allowlist keeps.
patch   : correct fields on a harvested event (bad coordinate, poor name).
add     : supply an event the harvest cannot reach — typically because
Wikidata has no P625 for it. Use the real QID so summaries and
narrative links still work; use a negative QID only for
Every entry needs a `why`. A year from now the reason is the only thing
